ling-morph-01-c1.text: Catherine Anderson, Bronwyn Bjorkman, Derek Denis, Julianne Doner, Margaret Grant, Nathan Sanders, Ai Taniguchi (2022). Essentials of Linguistics, 2nd edition: Allomorphy. LibreTexts Social Sciences (Essentials of Linguistics Remix 2.0).
ling-morph-01-c1.quote: If you pay attention, the plural adds the sound [s] in (1a), the sound [z] in (1b), and the sound [ɪz] or [əz] in (1c).
ling-morph-01-c1.claim: Say the plural morpheme -s aloud and you'll hear three different sounds in English: /s/ in cats, /z/ in dogs and /ɪz/ in buses.
